scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory apps/api fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir apps/web install && uv sync --directory apps/api
scripts.lint: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && pnpm --dir apps/web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --dir apps/web lint
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile livekit --profile livekit-test down
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.create-admin: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli create-admin
scripts.infra:livekit: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile livekit --profile livekit-test up -d --build
scripts.livekit-trunk: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli livekit-trunk
